An '''R2-series astromech droid''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a security droid at the [[Chancellor Palpatine Spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="DarkRendezvous">''[[Yoda: Dark Rendezvous]]''</ref>

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the R2 unit followed a suspicious [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]], who was [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] in disguise, into the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] [[Refresher/Legends|refresher]]. Yoda used the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|leviate]] himself out of a stall and trap the security R2 unit inside.<ref name="DarkRendezvous" />
